end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming small animals found in soil and leaf litter, including earthworms, ants, and beetles. They shared that they had seen an earthworm and asked questions about soil and water. The mix-up that all small crawling animals are insects was not corrected by the end. At home, you can sort pictures into “insect” and “not an insect,” including an ant, beetle, and earthworm.
